description: A new AttendeeResponseDto lists RegistrationResponseDto[], RegistrationResponseDto gets an optional workshop (WorkshopResponseDto) and WorkshopResponseDto an optional attendees list (AttendeeResponseDto[]), all through import type: a three-file cycle across three modules.

expectedFindings.reason: Three-file import cycle attendee-response -> registration-response -> workshop-response -> attendee-response; the smallest path is the attendees DTO and the next file is the registrations DTO.
